blocks.raw: # Copy and Paste a Dataflow
blocks.text: Copy and Paste a Dataflow

blocks.raw: You can use Aira Coder to copy and paste dataflows across organizations in the same cluster or across clusters. You use natural language prompts to copy and paste a dataflow. When you copy a dataflow, Neo stores it in your personal dataflow store that is attached to your email ID. You can view your stored dataflows using a *view prompt* and paste a selected dataflow onto the canvas using a *paste prompt*.
blocks.text: You can use Aira Coder to copy and paste dataflows across organizations in the same cluster or across clusters. You use natural language prompts to copy and paste a dataflow. When you copy a dataflow, Neo stores it in your personal dataflow store that is attached to your email ID. You can view your stored dataflows using a view prompt and paste a selected dataflow onto the canvas using a paste prompt.

blocks.raw: To paste a dataflow, you select a dataflow from your dataflow store. When you select it, Aira Coder automatically generates a predefined paste prompt that is used to paste the dataflow. You cannot edit the auto-generated prompt or write the prompt manually for the paste function.
blocks.text: To paste a dataflow, you select a dataflow from your dataflow store. When you select it, Aira Coder automatically generates a predefined paste prompt that is used to paste the dataflow. You cannot edit the auto-generated prompt or write the prompt manually for the paste function.

blocks.raw: To copy and paste a dataflow, you must use the *copy, view,* and *paste prompts* in sequence. For example, if you want to copy the dataflow *CheckCodeDiff* from Organization A to Organization B, follow this sequence:
blocks.text: To copy and paste a dataflow, you must use the copy, view, and paste prompts in sequence. For example, if you want to copy the dataflow CheckCodeDiff from Organization A to Organization B, follow this sequence:

blocks.raw:
* Use a copy prompt from any version of the dataflow you want to copy.\
  Example: *“Copy the dataflow CheckCodeDiff with the description ‘Move’.”*

* Use a view prompt in the target organization to view your dataflow store.\
  Example: *“View my dataflow store from the EU cluster.”*

* Use a paste prompt to paste the required version.\
  Example: *“Paste the dataflow CheckCodeDiff with version 4.”*

blocks.raw: ## Guidelines for using copy-paste prompts in Aira Coder
blocks.text: Guidelines for using copy-paste prompts in Aira Coder

blocks.raw: Follow these best practices when using the *copy-paste prompts* in Aira Coder:
blocks.text: Follow these best practices when using the copy-paste prompts in Aira Coder:

blocks.raw:
* Include a meaningful description for the action with every copy prompt. This is a mandatory requirement, and if the description is missing, the system prompts you to add one.\
  *Example:* “Copy this dataflow to my dataflow store with the description ‘Move’.”

* Specify a version number of the dataflow that you want to copy. This helps you to copy any version of the dataflow, irrespective of the version that is currently open. If you do not specify one, Neo copies the version of the dataflow that is currently open in the canvas.

* Specify the cluster from which you want to view your dataflow store.

blocks.raw: **What happens**
blocks.text: What happens

blocks.raw:
* Neo copies the saved version of the dataflow and ignores any unsaved changes on the canvas.

* Neo stores metadata such as the dataflow details, the cluster, your user information, and the organization ID associated with the dataflow.

* Neo adds the copied dataflow to your personal dataflow store.

blocks.raw: ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

blocks.raw: 1. What is the copy and paste feature used for?
blocks.text: What is the copy and paste feature used for?

blocks.raw: The copy and paste feature allows you to copy dataflows across organizations in the same cluster or across clusters using natural-language prompts in Aira Coder.
blocks.text: The copy and paste feature allows you to copy dataflows across organizations in the same cluster or across clusters using natural-language prompts in Aira Coder.

blocks.raw: 2. Do I need to follow a specific sequence while using this feature?
blocks.text: Do I need to follow a specific sequence while using this feature?

blocks.raw: Yes. You must use the prompts in the following order:
blocks.text: Yes. You must use the prompts in the following order:

blocks.raw:
1. *Copy* the dataflow.

2. *View* your dataflow store.

3. *Paste* the selected dataflow.
blocks.text: Copy the dataflow.View your dataflow store.Paste the selected dataflow.

blocks.raw: You cannot paste a dataflow without viewing and selecting it first.
blocks.text: You cannot paste a dataflow without viewing and selecting it first.

blocks.raw: 3. Can I copy a dataflow from any version?
blocks.text: Can I copy a dataflow from any version?

blocks.raw: Yes. You can trigger the copy action from any version of the same dataflow. However, you cannot copy a dataflow while another dataflow is open on the canvas.
blocks.text: Yes. You can trigger the copy action from any version of the same dataflow. However, you cannot copy a dataflow while another dataflow is open on the canvas.

blocks.raw: 4. Does the unsaved changes on the canvas get copied?
blocks.text: Does the unsaved changes on the canvas get copied?

blocks.raw:
Neo copies only the saved dataflow.\
Unsaved changes on the canvas are not copied.
blocks.text: Neo copies only the saved dataflow.Unsaved changes on the canvas are not copied.

blocks.raw: 5. Do I need to specify a version number in the copy prompt?
blocks.text: Do I need to specify a version number in the copy prompt?

blocks.raw:
No. Specifying a version number is optional.\
If you do not specify a version, Neo copies the version currently open on the canvas.
blocks.text: No. Specifying a version number is optional.If you do not specify a version, Neo copies the version currently open on the canvas.

blocks.text: What metadata is stored when I copy a dataflow?

* Dataflow details

* Cluster

* User information

* Organization ID associated with the dataflow

blocks.raw: 8. How many copied dataflows can I view?
blocks.text: How many copied dataflows can I view?

blocks.raw: Neo displays up to the ten most recently copied dataflows for the cluster you specify. If you do not specify a cluster, Neo shows the last ten dataflows from your dataflow store for your current cluster by default.
blocks.text: Neo displays up to the ten most recently copied dataflows for the cluster you specify. If you do not specify a cluster, Neo shows the last ten dataflows from your dataflow store for your current cluster by default.

blocks.raw: 9. Can I paste a dataflow into any organization?
blocks.text: Can I paste a dataflow into any organization?

blocks.raw: Yes, you can paste a dataflow into any organization in the same cluster or another cluster where you have access.
blocks.text: Yes, you can paste a dataflow into any organization in the same cluster or another cluster where you have access.

blocks.raw: 10. In what state does the pasted dataflow appear?
blocks.text: In what state does the pasted dataflow appear?

blocks.raw: Pasted dataflows always open in Draft state, allowing you to review and modify them before saving.
blocks.text: Pasted dataflows always open in Draft state, allowing you to review and modify them before saving.

blocks.raw: 11. Can I edit the pasted dataflow?
blocks.text: Can I edit the pasted dataflow?

blocks.raw: Yes. After pasting, you can edit the dataflow before saving it.
blocks.text: Yes. After pasting, you can edit the dataflow before saving it.

blocks.raw: 12. Can I preview the dataflow before pasting?
blocks.text: Can I preview the dataflow before pasting?

blocks.raw: Yes. Aira Coder provides a preview before applying the changes.
blocks.text: Yes. Aira Coder provides a preview before applying the changes.

blocks.raw: 13. Can I copy or paste multiple dataflows at once?
blocks.text: Can I copy or paste multiple dataflows at once?

blocks.raw: No. You can copy and paste only one dataflow at a time.
blocks.text: No. You can copy and paste only one dataflow at a time.

blocks.raw: For example, if you need to move ten dataflows from Organization A to Organization B, you must perform the copy, view, and paste sequence separately for each dataflow. The system does not support copying or pasting multiple dataflows in a single action.

blocks.raw: 14. Can a user with view-only permissions use this feature?
blocks.text: Can a user with view-only permissions use this feature?

blocks.raw: No. Users must have the Neo Edit permissions use Aira Coder for copy and paste.
blocks.text: No. Users must have the Neo Edit permissions use Aira Coder for copy and paste.

blocks.raw: 15. Can I use this feature to move the dataflow from one organization to another?
blocks.text: Can I use this feature to move the dataflow from one organization to another?

blocks.raw: No, you can only copy and paste the dataflow. The original dataflow will remain intact.
